manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the gum bottle on the red card.

Task description: The target is the green-and-white gum bottle lying horizontally on the table. Place it on the red card lying flat to its right.

Success criteria: The gum bottle has been picked up and placed on the red card, and remains stably on the card after the gripper opens.

## Execution tips

- Grip straight middle sidewalls of the bottle, avoiding cap edges and thickness transitions. Close transversely to its long axis and open slightly wider than the grasp section for full contact.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the bottle body and check fingertip clearance from the table, avoiding pressing the top of the body and rolling the bottle away.
- During transport, lift the bottle and fingertips clear of the table before moving sideways. Near the card, watch the sign and base to its right and leave room for the gripper.
- Choose a placement point on the card with clearance from its edge. Release gradually after the bottle contacts the card and is supported to reduce the risk of rolling off.

The bottle has lifted clear of the table with the gripper; its relative position in the wrist view is stable, and the measured gripper opening is about 51 mm. I am now carrying it above the red card while avoiding the sign on the right.
The bottle remained stable during transport and is above the left side of the red card. Next I will align it inside the card, then lower gradually to table support and release.
The bottle is aligned inside the red card with room for placement. I am completing the final small descent, then will release and check whether it remains stable on the card.
The gripper is open, and the bottle did not rise with it; it remains stable on the red card. I will lift a little farther for an unobstructed view, then end this episode.
